market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver futures currently trade near $32.5, requiring a >3.6x rally to $120 within ~14 months. Such a move is extremely rare historically and under any reasonable financial model (e.g., GBM with realistic volatility) the probability of hitting that barrier in finite time is far below 1%. The market-implied probability of 6.7% drastically overestimates the likelihood, making "No" a strong negative-edge pick.
evidence_points: Silver front-month settlement ~$32.5, target $120 is ~269% above current price.
Historical largest 12-month rallies rarely exceed 80–100%; the Hunt-brothers squeeze of 1979–80 saw a ~345% gain but was a unique event under different market structure.
Even assuming infinite time and zero drift, probability of ever hitting $120 is S0/L ≈ 27%; with drift and finite horizon, it’s far lower, on the order of 0.2%.
